JARVIS RD Assistant documentation

JARVIS RD Assistant is a self-hosted research workspace for scientific literature
discovery, source-linked RAG, PDF annotation, Zotero workflows, project tracking,
and spaced repetition.

Repository: https://github.com/limitcycle-oss/Jarvis-RD-Assistant
Documentation: https://limitcycle-oss.github.io/Jarvis-RD-Assistant/
License: Apache-2.0

Important boundaries

- Local-first means the default deployment and inference posture uses local
  infrastructure such as Ollama or vLLM when configured.
- Cloud providers are optional. If an administrator configures one, selected
  prompts and source excerpts are sent to that provider for the chosen task.
- "Verified" means an answer or claim is traceable to retrieved source text; it
  does not mean the scientific claim is independently proven correct.
- The canonical paper corpus is shared within a deployment, while user library
  state, annotations, tasks, exports, and review data are scoped to the user.
